title: Longterm Effects of a Biofield Patch on Anxiety, Sleep, and Energy
official: Clinical Trial on Long-Term Effects of a Biofield Patch on Anxiety, Sleep, and Energy. A Randomized Double-Blind Placebo-Controlled 4-week Trial.
summary: The goal for this clinical trial is to compare an active biofield non-transdermal skin patch to a placebo patch in people who frequently experience anxiety.
